- Offer as L5 Senior IC (strong IC with some leadership responsibilities)
- Offer as L5 Manager (people manager, 1 IC direct initially)

Can we get alignment on title (manager vs IC) and a compensation framework before I ask her preference? Would like to avoid re-opening conversation after offer. Dropping Greenhouse link below.

All — reviewed bands and budget. Short answers:
- Band fit: L5 Manager band covers the $180k–$220k base window. $200k base is within range; bonus at 10% (20k) is standard for manager band but we can approve a 12.5% prorated target for recruiting edge. Equity: 0.12%–0.18% is reasonable for this profile (proposal 0.15%).
- Sign-on: recommend one-time sign-on of $10k (taxable cash) given market and notice period.
- Equity / title consistency: If we proceed as L5 Manager, we should document scope (direct report count, P&L/roadmap ownership) in the offer so future leveling disputes are avoidable.

Marcus — headcount status? If approved for a manager slot, we should be able to consume one active hire this quarter. If we need a swap, we will need rapid reallocation.

Proposed offer summary to present to candidate (if manager):
- Base: $200,000
- Bonus: 12.5% target (pro-rated first year)
- Equity: 0.15% (4-year vest)
- Sign-on: $10,000 one-time
- Start: mid-June

If we choose L5 Senior IC instead the comp mix shifts: base $195k, bonus 10%, equity 0.20% (higher equity to offset lack of manager premium).

I approve moving forward with the L5 Manager structure if hiring manager confirms scope.

Tessa Morgan
